author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a square-cornered frame packed with three straight arrows whose heads jammed against each other and the walls; no wavy airflow, so it read as an upload/boost sign. After: a rounded unit with two arrows whose chevrons sit clear inside it and whose shafts cross the bottom edge into S-shaped airflow tails, as in the reference; reads at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Three arrows reduced to two: three chevrons inside the 40-wide unit cannot keep 8 from each other and from the walls.
